author: Oulanos65
body:
The 5 turns with beo is with the Prometheus pet build. You can even get to 39M damage total per turn. Ask in orna legends discord for the build. But you have to have very specific amities and gear for it to work. And now it’s been nerfed to half damage I think since the anguish 2 release. But still insane. 

I am laughing so much at people saying Beowulf is not a fast raider. Clearly they’ve got no idea what they are talking about and it shows.

body: If you have have 103 Al why go BeoH for raids just use Arisen Spiritgarm BeoA. He hits for 10mil even for me with "only" 38 Al in Beo

author: KevineCove
body:
There are a bunch. BeoA, RS, DAra, and Here are all good raiders, though in your case BeoA makes the most sense. 

BeoH is never going to be as fast as these classes because that's not what it's built for. Slap on like 2 of your strongest buffs instead of trying to go for all of them.
